text: They built a fire to burn him. Then Allah gave it one command.
After Hazrat Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, broke their idols, his people were furious.
They said: burn him, and support your gods.
So they built a huge fire, and threw him into it.
Then Allah gave the fire one command.
O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
The fire obeyed its Creator. It could not harm him.
When Allah is with you, no fire is stronger.
